d: "There's always something extraordinary happening at Australia Zoo! From caring for giant crocodiles and adorable baby koalas to looking after kangaroos, wombats and other fascinating wildlife, the Irwin family has a busy day ahead. Robert, Bindi and Terri Irwin continue Steve Irwin's legacy through their work in animal care, wildlife rescue and conservation, giving visitors a closer look at the incredible animals that call the zoo home.
